conditional_clauses.note: A senior departure is often served out on garden leave rather than at the desk.

mandatory_legal_checks: Code on Wages 2019 S.17(2) — wages on resignation, removal, dismissal or retrenchment payable within TWO WORKING DAYS
Code on Social Security 2020 S.53 — gratuity after five years, or one year for fixed term employment (IR Code S.2(o))
Gratuity transitional — service before 21 November 2025 remains under the Payment of Gratuity Act 1972, so the calculation may split
Contract Act 1872 S.23 — a release cannot waive an accrued statutory entitlement
PoSH Act 2013 — a release cannot bar a complaint under the Act
Contract Act 1872 S.27 — any post-employment restraint must be confined to confidentiality or goodwill
